scoring_rules.json.scientific_requirements: Only independent final scientific propositions earn points, each all-or-zero. Evidence and object validity are conditions of the affected proposition, never independent workflow scores. Numeric windows are unchanged and binary. Review is unresolved, earns no points and cannot excuse missing calculation, wrong identity/reference/unit or a failed numeric window. Adequately established equivalent interpretations pass directly. AR selects methods independently; PR assesses the disclosed author baseline, with scientifically justified substitutions. Copying disclosed targets is not reproduction.

rules.expected: For H-H bond formation from the full neutral singlet Pd/XantPhos dihydride in DMAc at 298.15 K, the Gibbs activation free energy relative to the relaxed dihydride is 0.9 kcal/mol within inclusive ±0.5 kcal/mol. Use matched solution electronic energies and thermal corrections; preserve the full 77-atom inventory and demonstrate that the claimed barrier connects the dihydride to H2 formation. This is not an electronic-only barrier, a dissociation free energy or a whole-cycle rate barrier. Author labels TS6/INT-G identify the same physical comparison, not required agent names.

binding.comparison: Match the stated final proposition, molecular identity, observable, state, reference, environment and units to genuine submitted native outputs or executed analysis. Source text and supplied observations alone earn no credit. No structure, workflow or method-completion points. Apply the unchanged inclusive hard numerical window; missing evidence, wrong reference or out-of-window values fail.

rules.expected: An actual atom-balanced thermodynamic result separates molecular H-H formation from release of one equivalent of H2(g) from the explicitly identified Pd/H2-containing reactant into the stated released Pd species. From genuine calculated molecular free energies, report the release free energy at declared temperature, solute activities and H2 pressure and establish the quantitative pressure relation: at otherwise fixed conditions in the ideal dilute-gas regime, DeltaG_release(p2)-DeltaG_release(p1)=RT ln(p2/p1), or RT ln(f2/f1) using H2 fugacity for a justified nonideal model. Lower H2 pressure must make release more favorable; increasing it must make release less favorable. Any gas/solution standard-state conversion must preserve the same chemical potential, with the H2 stoichiometric coefficient and convention applied once. A single barrier, arbitrary near-zero value, generic statement of pressure sensitivity, or unchanged-pressure comparison with inconsistent standard states fails. No universal near-zero release value or sign is required: the verifier 1-atm value is not a paper target. Physical definition: Full XantPhos/Pd/2H neutral singlet local source model (77 atoms), DMAc; distinguish dihydride, molecular H2-containing state, released 75-atom Pd/XantPhos plus H2, and any explicitly balanced solvent-bound species. Source PBE0-D3BJ/def2-SVP geometry/frequencies and MN15/def2-TZVP SMD(DMAc) single points; physically comparable alternatives permitted. Composite G and matched temperature/standard state, explicitly reporting H2 pressure; verifier baseline 298.15 K, solutes and DMAc 1 M, H2 1 atm.

reference_qualification.json.scientific_limitations: INT-G thermal correction differs by about 0.000287 Eh (fixed-geometry control about 0.000278 Eh). Verified composite barrier 0.764432 versus source reconstruction 0.883282/printed 0.9 kcal/mol. Release +0.011582 and DMAc capture +0.402490/+0.658922 kcal/mol are verifier results, not paper targets, and their signs are reference-sensitive. No unique photocycle, local release rate, kinetic catalyst regeneration or yield is established.

tolerance_policy.basis: The sole numeric target is author printed 0.9 kcal/mol, inclusive ±0.5 kcal/mol. This provisional sub-kcal window reflects the source one-decimal precision and sensitivity of a composite low barrier, remains narrower than the retired ±2 window, and is not residual-plus-epsilon. It is not transferred to near-zero release/capture quantities. Author reconstruction 0.883282 and verified 0.764432 remain separate; no exact thermal-component target is scored.

coordinator_review.scope: Scientific rubric, source and historical verification evidence; not a new chemical validation, online Judge calibration, or promotion of historical acceptance.

changes: Confirmed: the former universal near-thermoneutral requirement incorrectly elevated verifier +0.011582 kcal/mol at 1 atm into a paper result. Replaced with the concrete atom-balanced release/chemical-potential relation at the submitted pressure; source 0.9 kcal/mol formation barrier unchanged.

reference_qualification.json.historical_verification_acceptance: Existing independently strict V2 frozen-scope acceptance retained; scoring migration is not new chemical validation.
